rubric.role_summary: Senior channel solution engineer supporting partners’ enterprise software sales cycles in Latin America through technical solution design, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and proposals.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior channel solution engineer supporting partners’ enterprise software sales cycles in Latin America through technical solution design, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and proposals.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience combining technical elements with clients’ business needs and requirements.
- Experience delivering software demonstrations.
- Understanding of digital marketing technologies.
- Experience conducting business across LATAM, with understanding of regional business practices, cultures, and market dynamics.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience and understanding of one or more web content management, e-commerce, or digital asset management systems.
- Understanding of the MarTech landscape and trends, including SaaS and headless content solutions.
- Experience demonstrating software using a value-based approach.
- Ability to resolve complex technical issues and integrate multiple products to create solutions.
- Understanding of cross-channel digital marketing technologies.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): USA. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
